title: Validate a Page Request Contract
summary: Parse page and pageSize query values into a safe paging window with actionable validation errors.
objectives: Apply defaults for omitted query values.
Reject malformed numbers and out-of-range paging values.
Derive a safe offset without throwing from a request parser.
constraints: Use page 1 and pageSize 20 when a value is null, empty, or whitespace.
Return invalid_page before invalid_page_size when both are invalid.
Never throw for invalid input; return a result with IsValid false and an error code.

examples.explanation: Missing values fall back to the default window.

public.name: Default window
public.description: Omitted values become page 1 and pageSize 20.

public.name: Custom window
public.description: A valid page and pageSize produce the expected offset.

hidden.name: Allowed boundaries
hidden.description: The minimum and maximum page and pageSize values are accepted.

hidden.name: Invalid values
hidden.description: Malformed and out-of-range values return an error code instead of throwing.

hidden.name: Validation precedence
hidden.description: Page errors take precedence, and whitespace around valid numbers is tolerated.
